data.name: Careful Disarm
data.description: Whenever you attempt to disarm a trap using Disable Device, you do not spring the trap unless you fail by 10 or more. If you do set off a trap you were attempting to disarm, you adds double your trap sense bonus to avoid the trap. This ability replaces uncanny dodge.
